name: mcportal
description: Your personal, agent-composed reading room: portals onto Hacker News, GitHub and any RSS feed, arranged the way you ask, with reader view and no ads.
long_description: MCPortal is your reading room inside your agent. Open it to see portals onto the sources you follow (any site with a feed, Hacker News, GitHub, documentation sites), arranged the way you ask. Read articles and docs without the clutter, save links, clip things from the conversation, and import or export your subscriptions. This bundle runs MCPortal on your computer: your room lives in ~/.mcportal and nothing is sent anywhere but the sites you follow.

tools.name: open_room
tools.description: Open the user's MCPortal room: their portals onto their sources (Hacker News, GitHub, RSS, and data pinned from their other tools), arranged by their saved layout.

tools.name: build_room
tools.description: Set up the user's room from up to 4 starter packs (ids from open_room's setup, e.g.

tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Return the user's saved MCPortal profile: the layout, and each portal with its source settings (each column stores its portals as panels).

tools.name: update_profile
tools.description: Save the user's layout: send the COMPLETE profile from get_profile with only the changes they asked for.

tools.name: read_source
tools.description: Fetch items from one source without changing the room (for questions like "what's new on Hacker News?" or previewing a feed before adding it).

tools.name: find_source
tools.description: Work out what MCPortal can show for something the user wants to follow, and preview it.

tools.name: add_portal
tools.description: Add one portal to the user's room.

tools.name: list_sources
tools.description: Describe the source types MCPortal can show in a portal and the settings each accepts.

tools.name: import_opml
tools.description: Bring the user's subscriptions in from another feed reader (Feedly, NetNewsWire, Inoreader…): pass the contents of their OPML export.

tools.name: read_article
tools.description: Fetch a web page and return a clean reader-view version (title, byline, plain-text paragraphs).

tools.name: save_item
tools.description: Save a link to the user's MCPortal (a bookmark), or update the title or note of one already saved.

tools.name: remove_saved
tools.description: Remove one link from the user's saved items.

tools.name: pin_portal
tools.description: Show results from another of the user's tools (Jira, Slack, Drive, a database, …) as a portal in their room: you fetch them with that tool and pass short items here; MCPortal never contacts it.

tools.name: open_docs
tools.description: Open a documentation site in the docs viewer (contents, search, the page, on-this-page), shown as its own card.

tools.name: read_doc_page
tools.description: Read one page of a docs site as clean text: headings, code, tables and callouts.

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Find pages in a docs site by title, description and section, and on Sphinx sites (Python, Django, NumPy…) functions and classes by name ("str.split").

tools.name: clip
tools.description: Keep something from this chat (or an article) in the user's clips, only when they ask to clip or keep it; a link to read later is save_item.

tools.name: search_clips
tools.description: Find the user's clips by words, kind or tag, newest first.

tools.name: get_clip
tools.description: Show one of the user's clips in full, as a card in the conversation ("show me that table").

tools.name: update_clip
tools.description: Change a clip's title, note or tags.

tools.name: delete_clip
tools.description: Delete one of the user's clips.

tools.name: export_data
tools.description: Give the user a copy of their MCPortal data.

tools.name: import_portal
tools.description: Add an MCPortal export file (format "mcportal-export") to the user's room: portals they don't have, saved items and clips.

tools.name: account_settings
tools.description: Link to the user's MCPortal account page, where they sign in with GitHub to download everything or delete their account.

tools.name: record_reading
tools.description: Record explicit seen, opened or read activity for one URL.

tools.name: get_reading
tools.description: Get the caller’s durable reading state for a URL; fragments share the same URL identity.

tools.name: list_reading
tools.description: List recent unfinished reading (actually opened, not completed), newest opened first.
